findings.title: brand-bound editor lists every Brand
findings.detail: Invited Editor bound to PageFlo Rescue Acceptance 944138 only. Sidebar: Editor · 1 brand. /admin/sites still renders All 8 Brands including Dont Settle, ACH, and other rescue Brands, with primary domains. Root cause: src/app/(app)/admin/(top)/sites/page.tsx payload.find/count overrideAccess: true. Direct /admin/sites/dont-settle 404s via isBoundToSite. Leads UI scoped (SITES IN SCOPE 1, Ada Lovelace hidden). Advertorial deployments in this probe did not show Dont Settle /adv/letter. GET /api/sites 403. Local pnpm test:isolation 50/0. Listing is the hole; mutation of Brand settings was blocked.
